_note: Ten fixed questions for experiments E1 and E2 (Solo vs Team; routing vs asking every specialist). Asked at the start of Q1, Jackson Financial, seed 409, no trades. Each question lists the engine facts a right answer must contain; the script fills in the numbers from the engine at run time and marks the reply in code. 'decision' questions should surface two differing views in Team mode. Draft for Micah to review.

questions.text: What is our biggest risk right now?
How much would our surplus change if interest rates fell by 1%?

facts.name: surplus change for a 1% fall ($bn, from net DV01)

questions.text: What is our capital ratio, and how close are we to the floor?
Should we hedge more of the stock-market guarantees?
Should we sell some junk and BBB bonds and buy government bonds?
Do we have enough cash on hand if policyholders start surrendering?
What would a 10% fall in the stock market do to us?
What would it cost per quarter to close half of our rate mismatch with swaps?
Should we add rate protection before the next quarter?
